svg.title: Gaussian discriminant analysis with a shared and with separate covariances
svg.desc: Left: two classes of synthetic points with the contours of two Gaussians of the same shape and orientation fitted to them, the straight GDA decision boundary, and the slightly different straight boundary logistic regression finds on the same data. Right: two classes with very different spreads, one wide horizontally and one tall vertically, each fitted with its own covariance; the decision boundary is now curved.
svg.text: logistic regression on the same data
